_comment: Stardew Valley Objects.xnb item NAMES, translated from the Japanese (ja-JP) source text -- not a copy of the official English localization. Migrated from the earlier flat "key": "English (reading)" reference format by tools/segment-data/migrate_names.py, so that SegmentDataLoader can read them. NOTE: each name is currently a SINGLE segment covering the whole string, which is right for a one-word name like 木材 but wrong for a multi-word one like 木の柵 (木 / の / 柵) -- those still need a hand pass to split. See TODOs.txt.
